full_text:
Article 6 (Disclosure of Reports on Important Audit Results, etc.)
(1) Within one month after reporting important audit results, etc., the Board of Audit and Inspection shall provide the Legislation and Judiciary Committee of the National Assembly with information on whether such a report has been made and a list of matters audited and reported, and other relevant details. <Amended on Nov. 2, 2020>
(2) Where the Legislation and Judiciary Committee of the National Assembly requests access to a report on important audit results, etc., the Board of Audit and Inspection shall make arrangements for the Committee to inspect the report on a non-public basis; provided, matters not subject to disclosure under Article 9 (1) of the Official Information Disclosure Act and similar matters shall be excluded. <Amended on Nov. 2, 2020>
